title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
slides: Why do Pincus and Hoffman need $100M now?
Prentis blends gaming data with AI models.
Their secret weapon: behavior-based synthetic training data.
Developers could build smarter game NPCs instantly.
Watch their demo before your competitor does.
thread_text:
1. Why do they need $100M now?

They burned through cash building AI that plays games better than humans.

2. Prentis blends gaming data with AI models.

Every move a player makes becomes fuel for a neural net.

3. Their secret weapon: behavior-based synthetic training data.

Instead of real users, they generate fake but realistic player patterns at scale.

4. Developers could build smarter game NPCs instantly.

No manual scripting. Just plug in the model and get enemies that adapt to you.

5. Watch their demo before your competitor does.

Open their site, click the demo button, and see how fast your NPCs can learn.

instagram.caption:
10,000 game developers just got a $100M target on their back—Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus are raising that cash now for their new lab, Prentis.

They already trained AI on the behavioral data from millions of actual game moves. Their secret sauce isn't more users—it's synthetic player patterns, faked but realistic at scale.

This means you can plug in a model and get NPCs that adapt to you instantly, no manual scripting. The old way of hard-coding enemy reactions? Dead.

What game mechanic would you gut first if your NPCs learned from every player’s mistake? Open their demo and test how fast your next boss fight can think.
